vocabulary.definition: to change from a liquid to a gas, usually as a result of heating
vocabulary.example: The sun evaporates the water in the puddles after the rain.

vocabulary.definition: to change from a gas to a liquid
vocabulary.example: When the steam cools down, it condenses into water droplets.

vocabulary.definition: having a pH level lower than 7, indicating a higher concentration of hydrogen ions
vocabulary.example: The lemon juice tasted very acidic.

vocabulary.definition: to gather or collect over time
vocabulary.example: Dust tends to accumulate on the shelves if not cleaned regularly.

vocabulary.definition: the concentration of dissolved salts in water
vocabulary.example: The salinity of the Dead Sea is much higher than that of regular oceans.

vocabulary.definition: small amounts or hints of something
vocabulary.example: The detective found traces of evidence at the crime scene.
